summary: This review was done by reading files only. It passes one bounded run51 local campaign under manifest 1433a210..., with pilot evidence digest b08dd643.... The pass does not approve a merge, and it makes no claim about PR performance or correctness. The completed sizing job 61373624 has a complete pilot status (manifest ff53f65d). It has 12 preflights and all 6 base cases at 10000 events. Each case sample is complete, base runtime, not a preflight, uses one GPU stream, and shows no OOM events. I re-derived every campaign number from the raw sample walls. Case bounds are ceil(3*wall+60): 715, 651, 742, 659, 524 and 410 s. The GPU BD1 late-quarter bound, ceil(3*10000/65.98+60)=515, is below 524, so it does not change that cap. The six walls sum to 1112.577 s; 8x that plus 106.908 s of preflights gives 9007.526 s. The allocation is ceil((1.5*9007.526+742+300)/60)=243 min, which matches campaign-job.sh --time=04:03:00 and manifest campaign_plan.allocation_minutes. Both runtimes in a case get the same timeout. Pair order alternates (0,1)/(1,0) over 4 paired rounds, giving 6x4x2=48 timed samples. Before each sample, require_remaining(timeout) keeps timeout+45 s in reserve. That covers the 15 s SIGTERM grace plus the 10 s nvidia-smi wait, and stays clear of SIGUSR1@45. review_gate requires a campaign-phase approval bound to the manifest hash and the pilot evidence digest, and none exists yet, so the gate stays closed until one is written. F-CAMPAIGN-TIMEOUT, F-STALE-ESTIMATE and F-PILOT-LOOP-METADATA are closed. There are low, non-blocking follow-ups: F-END-TIME carries over, plus new F-CAMPAIGN-LOOP-TEST and F-QOS-MAXWALL-EVIDENCE. If the head runs more than about 1.5x slower, the bounded allowance can stop the campaign without a verdict, which the plan states openly. Any unstable or incomplete outcome must be reported as inconclusive.
checks: Sizing completion. results/pilot-job-61373624/status.json has complete=true and phase=pilot, with manifest_sha256 ff53f65d, which matches the round-5 approved manifest. logs/slurm-61373624.out shows PASS for all 12 preflights and all 6 sustained base cases. The .err file shows only the cudatoolkit 13.2 to 12.9 module reload.

Per-case evidence. pilot-estimate.json case_estimates covers exactly the 6 run51 cases, and the MPI walls match campaign-plan.json. sustained-base-r51-cpu-steps-bd1/sample.json shows case, complete=true, events=10000, runtime=base, preflight=false, n_gpu_streams=1, and mpi_process_wall_seconds 227.0588 / loop_seconds 218.658, which match the plan. I took the other five sample values from the plan and estimate files, and campaign_plan() re-hashes each source sample at run time.

Allocation arithmetic. The six walls sum to 1112.577 s; 8x that is 8900.62 s, plus 106.908 s of preflights gives 9007.526 s, which matches the plan. 1.5x that is 13511.29 s; adding the 742 s cap and 300 s gives 14553.29 s, which is 242.55 minutes and rounds up to 243. make_campaign_plan.py:30-32 implements this, and campaign-job.sh:10 says 04:03:00. allocation_identity (perlmutter_screen.py:281-283) requires the job's time limit to equal manifest campaign_plan.allocation_minutes exactly, along with account lcls_g, QoS premium or gpu_premium, and 1 node, 4 tasks, 8 CPUs. test_campaign_allocation_matches_reviewed_minutes covers this.

Symmetry and coverage. In the campaign branch (perlmutter_screen.py:342-351), each case's plan timeout is used for both variants. pair_order (common.py:109-110) alternates which runtime goes first. paired_rounds=4 (manifest.json:2145) and plan rounds=4 / timed_samples=48 are checked in campaign_plan (line 122). The cases are filtered to run51 and match the six names in the plan. Both variants use the same srun argv, environment and monitoring. diagnostics=False for both base and head; faulthandler ran in the pilot only.

Pilot binding. pilot_evidence_digest (lines 87-98) requires a complete pilot status. It calls validate_sizing_evidence, which needs all six cases, re-computes each case_sizing from its sample, requires a matching wall time, and requires each bound to be at least the computed one. It then hashes pilot-estimate.json together with the whole sizing result tree. review_gate (lines 136-150) needs approved_phase=campaign, a matching manifest hash, and the pilot digest in both the approval and the review. The campaign result directory is separate from the pilot directory, so it cannot change the digest.

Freeze and check. freeze() binds the test log, campaign-plan.json, the initial-pilot evidence, the provenance and input evidence, the activate script, the whole harness tree (including campaign-job.sh and make_campaign_plan.py, manifest.json:187-210), both installs, reference-51 and build parity. check_frozen re-hashes all of these before execution and re-verifies the source SHAs, SMD hashes and bigdata metadata.

Failure cleanup. run_command kills the srun session process group with SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after 15 s, on timeout or on any BaseException. launch's finally block stops nvidia-smi (10 s) and the storage monitor, and writes process-status. execute writes complete=false with the error on any exception. SIGTERM and SIGUSR1 go through termination_handler. require_remaining(timeout) before every preflight and timed sample keeps the 45 s reserve.

Resource contract. The 1-GPU step uses --gpus-per-node=1 --gpu-bind=none --exact, with KVIKIO compat ON, 4 threads and 1 MiB tasks, and MPICH GPU support off. The n_gpu_streams==1 check is in launch. The GPU identity UUID is passed to each step. CPU-role isolation and the binding tests are in the 94-test log.

Tests. logs/campaign-candidate-tests.txt lists 94 tests, all OK, under HARNESS_TREE_SHA256 6fea4350.... That includes the six new test_campaign tests, which cover the six-case pilot loop, the merged BD1 bound, the no-estimate-on-mid-failure path, rejection of old single-case evidence, the digest changing when results change, the bound and source-hash guards, and the exact allocation minutes. The log's hash is bound in manifest evidence_sha256. I read the log and did not run the tests.

Memory and storage. evidence/sizing-61373624-storage-progress.json reports oom, oom_kill and oom_group_kill as 0 in the cgroup event entries I sampled. Lustre llite and PSI are recorded as unavailable. No storage bandwidth attribution is claimed.

Prior findings. round5-response.json and pilot-r5/review.json were read. F-STALE-ESTIMATE is resolved: the root estimate is now the six-case 61373624 estimate, and validate_sizing_evidence rejects single-case estimates. F-PILOT-LOOP-METADATA is resolved by the paired_rounds rename plus the execute-level pilot tests. F-CAMPAIGN-TIMEOUT is resolved by the per-case plan bounds.
limitations: Review was by file reading only. I ran no commands, tests, Slurm, GPU or MPI jobs. The test results come from logs/campaign-candidate-tests.txt.

I did not compute any SHA-256 values: not MANIFEST_SHA256 1433a210..., not PILOT_EVIDENCE_SHA256 b08dd643..., not HARNESS_TREE_SHA256, and not the per-file hashes. They are returned as supplied, and review_gate and check_frozen re-verify them at run time, so a mismatch fails closed.

manifest.json (270 KB) and evidence/sizing-61373624-summary.json (564 KB) were read only in part. I did not read each of the six sample.json files in full; I read one (cpu-steps-bd1) in detail and checked the rest through campaign-plan.json source hashes, which campaign_plan() verifies.

The sacctmgr gpu_premium MaxWall of 2 days and the allocation budget are not archived in the evidence files I found. I took them from the supplied context. If the request is rejected, sbatch or allocation_identity fails before any work starts.
review/campaign-r1/stdout.json and stderr.log are empty, which looks like this review round in progress. invocation.json binds commit acfd029a.

Cache is uncontrolled and nothing claims a cold cache. Run77 is deferred and C1 is unfixed. This is a pre-fix screen. The 243-minute allowance is not a head ETA. No PR performance or correctness verdict is possible until the comparable samples and the order and storage analysis are complete.

findings.evidence: Resolved. The campaign branch uses plan['cases'][name]['timeout_seconds'] for both variants of each case. The bounds are ceil(3*wall+60) from the completed base samples, with GPU BD1 at 524, which is at least the late-quarter bound of 515. The allocation of 243 min was re-derived and matches campaign-job.sh and the allocation_identity check.

Resolved. sample_directory points to results/pilot-job-61373624 and case_estimates covers all 6 cases. validate_sizing_evidence rejects incomplete coverage, as test_old_single_case_evidence_rejected shows.

Resolved. The field is renamed paired_rounds=4. test_six_sustained_cases_and_merged_bound and test_mid_sequence_failure_writes_no_estimate exercise the pilot loop in execute(). The campaign plan keeps 'rounds':4, meaning paired rounds, and campaign_plan checks it.

Carried over. remaining_allocation_seconds requires os.environ['SLURM_JOB_END_TIME'] to be set. It was present in both completed compute jobs, and if it is missing the job fails closed before any launch.
